title: Noir week, i
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: The strip tries being SLASH for a week. Trench coat. Neon. Played straight. Unsigned.

panels.composition: SMALL WOOD LANES at night, but drawn as noir: the neon a slab of white, the rain a curtain, the lot a black mirror. A figure in a trench coat under the sign. It is WOOD, drawn as someone else.
panels.caption: The rain had been falling on Small Wood for eleven years. Nobody had thought to ask it why.

image.prompt: a bowling alley at night drawn in hard-boiled noir style, the neon sign a slab of white light, rain a solid curtain, the parking lot a black mirror, a figure in a trench coat and hat under the sign, brush-pen black and white, no gray

panels.composition: The trench coat. A cigarette he doesn't smoke, unlit. The brim.
panels.caption: He didn't smoke. He carried one for the shape of it.

image.prompt: close-up of a man in a fedora and trench coat with an unlit cigarette, hard noir shadows

panels.composition: The dumpster, but noir: chain-link, the bulb, a shadow that could be a body and is a crab pot.
panels.caption: Behind the Lanes, something was waiting. It was a crab pot. It was always a crab pot.

image.prompt: a noir alley behind a bowling alley with a chain-link fence, a bare bulb and a menacing shadow that is clearly a crab pot

panels.composition: The figure walking away into rain. No dog. The absence of the dog is the strangest thing in the strip.
panels.caption: He walked. The rain followed. Neither had anywhere else to be.

image.prompt: a trench-coated figure walking away down a rain-curtained alley at night, noir, no dog anywhere, black and white
image.notes: No dog. The noir has no room for him. Readers noticed.

art.line: brush-pen, committed; xerox; black and white

notes: Noir Week, day one. Captions instead of balloons. Played entirely straight. The dog is absent for the only week of his life.
